scope: frontend SUBSCRIBE_TO_FUNNEL step form (types/funnel.ts, FunnelStepForm.vue, i18n uk/en, funnel-editor.spec.ts)
summary: Implementation is clean, mirrors the established MENU/EMIT_EVENT idioms (sentinel for null, lazy loader with a request-guard, SearchableSelect with show-value=false for internal ids). Cross-file usage verified: store.fetch('all')/fetchOne(id).steps signatures and FunnelSummaryResponse.status all match. The targetEntryStepId naming (Decision 5) and the four funnel_subscribe_* error codes are byte-correct and locale-symmetric (check-locales.mjs green). One minor UX finding on the target picker loading state.

findings.finding: The target picker binds :loading="storeFunnels.length === 0". For a project that legitimately has no other funnels, fetch('all') resolves to an empty array and the picker shows the loading spinner indefinitely instead of the empty-state text (subscribeTargetEmpty). Other pickers in this file (tag/cf) use an explicit *Loading ref that flips false after the fetch settles.
findings.recommendation: Track an explicit subscribeFunnelsLoading ref (set true in ensureFunnelsLoaded, false in finally) and bind :loading to it, so the empty-state shows once the fetch completes. Low impact (cosmetic, only the genuinely-empty-project case), but it diverges from the file's own loader pattern.

findings.finding: store.fetch('all') overwrites the shared funnels.value (the list page's filtered slice) — a deliberate side-effect, documented inline with a fallback path (local useApi fetch). Acknowledged trade-off per task spec, not a defect.

The onSubmit switch still has no default/assertNever guard; the new case 'SUBSCRIBE_TO_FUNNEL' is present and exercised by the 'SUBSCRIBE submit shape' tests, so the silent-no-emit risk called out in the task is covered. Adding assertNever was optional and skipped to keep the diff minimal.

tests: vitest 458 passed (44 in funnel-editor.spec.ts incl. 5 new SUBSCRIBE), check-locales.mjs green
